definitions.zs: Recorded sprung corner displacement; sign and reference preserved.
definitions.roll: theta[0] = front roll; theta[1] = rear roll.
definitions.heave: Recorded chassis s[2]; not the mean of the four corner displacements.
definitions.steering: Recorded wheel steer angles; no additional steering geometry is inferred.
definitions.acceleration: Recorded body-frame a = [ax, ay, az]; no gravity adjustment.
definitions.speed: sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2); vertical heave velocity excluded.

unsprung.reference: Static equilibrium at zero speed and acceleration on flat road.

input_metadata.description: Planned full-lap speed map exported as Vehicle_state samples.
input_metadata.unsprung_reference: Static equilibrium at zero speed and acceleration on flat road.
input_metadata.note: Generated from simplified steady-state speed planning. Front/rear roll are set equal for aero attitude; dynamic suspension fields are kinematic estimates, not full transient suspension output.
